title: Bram and the Portrait
author: Lena Villalobos
blurb: Wren Quintana, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
